targets: F2/F3 transport request-head parse (aegis-transport h1 fields)

acceptance.cmd: ci/fuzz.sh run --execs 100000000 (per target, on the LAN box)
acceptance.must: every target reaches 1e8 executions with 0 crashes, panics, timeouts or OOM; each target's self-test (a planted panic behind a fuzz-only cfg) is found within 1e6 executions; corpora committed under fuzz/corpus (minimized)

tooling: nightly toolchain and cargo-fuzz installed only in the isolated LAN toolchain (~/aegis-ci), pinned in ci/tools.lock; fuzz/ is a separate workspace so the shipped graph is unchanged
